description: Source code for a TypeScript module defining a code interpreter tool that executes Python code in a sandbox environment, with classes for tool initialization, execution, and handling artifacts.

classes.name: Code_Interpreter_Tools
classes.description: Implements an interface for a node that initializes and manages a code interpreter tool.

classes.name: E2BTool
classes.description: Represents a sandboxed Python code execution tool with methods for initialization and code execution, including artifact handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the tool with configuration data, including credentials and schema.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Executes the provided code in the sandbox environment, manages callbacks, and returns the output.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Performs the actual code execution in the sandbox, processes results, and handles artifacts.

methods.name: setFlowObject
methods.description: Sets the flow object context for the tool.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the tool with specified options.
